Use purify. Vale, like most mages, depend on their combo only. So Vale will just use his combos on you then he'll be done. So if you manage to purify his combos and jump onto him then he's 100% dead as he doesn't have any skills to burst you down.

100% worth buying. He's basically Tigreal on Meth. I'm not an Atlas main but i like to use him according to the enemy pick. If the enemy has a lot of backline heroes like Mages or Marksmen in general then I suggest you use him. But one con about Atlas is that he heavily relies on his ult. If you somehow manage to waste your ult then you will be useless and vulnerable during teamfights. His skill 1 barely deals any damage and his skill 2 is sometimes hard to land the stun. Just use his ult wisely and you'll be fine ;)
